rows: Where to read the pprof profile(s) to decode. Pass a filesystem path to one gzip-wrapped or raw `profile.proto` file; a path containing glob wildcards such as '/profiles/*.pb.gz' expands to every match in sorted order. A LIST value is read as several such paths scanned together; a BLOB value is read as inline profile bytes. Each file is decoded on its own so that a profile which is absent or fails to decode becomes a single error row (data columns NULL, `file` and `error` set) instead of failing the scan.
